messages:
ashley: Quick question — for the v6->v7 migration we keep hearing clients sending mixed payloads with the new optional "annotation_chunks" array. Do we want a gateway-level shim to coerce old shapes into the new one or push a lightweight adapter into the sidecar?

mike: Gateway shim is tempting (single place to fix), but it adds per-request CPU and could increase p50. Concerned about adding heavy parsing at the edge. :thinking_face:

divya: Sidecar adapter avoids touching the gateway fast path. But then every tenant needs the sidecar and we lose the single-rollout advantage. Also harder to enforce telemetry uniformly.

samir: One middle ground: gateway does a cheap fast-path check for a header and only shims if header indicates legacy client. That keeps common-case cost low. e.g.:
```
if not req.headers.get('x-rw-accepts-annotations'):
  rewrite_payload_to_include_empty_annotation_chunks(req)
```
But need to be careful about content-size copying.

oli: Agree with samir but will need a circuit breaker. If rewrite starts adding >1% CPU, flip it off. Also we should sample requests and validate transformation correctness with a small A/B test.

ashley: Good notes. What about cache invalidation? If we rewrite payloads we may change signatures used by prefix/KV cache and break cache hits.

mike: Right — simplest is to canonicalize before cache key computation. Gateway shim should run prior to cache key calc. That keeps cache consistent at cost of extra work for a subset of requests.

divya: For telemetry, we should add a new tag `shims.annotation_chunks=rewritten|passthrough` and emit latency/cpu deltas. Also log an example payload diff for 1 in 10k requests.

samir: Rollout plan I propose: 1) feature-flag gateway shim off by default; 2) enable for 1% of traffic with validation; 3) ramp to 25% if no regressions; 4) enable safety kill-switch that instantly stops rewriting.

oli: Add a daily job to reconcile client versions from usage logs — if legacy clients drop below 0.1% for 30 days, we schedule deprecation notice.

ashley: Sounds actionable. Action items: @mike prototype cheap header-check + rewrite before cache, @divya add telemetry tags and sample diffs, @samir wire rollout flag and kill-switch, @oli produce cost delta estimates. I'll open a short RFC with the plan and timeline. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-checklist created (id: dc-1750-annot-shim) — includes load-test job and 24h rollback monitor.
